description: A broad context-level feature for mentions and references to domestic cats across varied discourse. It should respond strongly to explicit cat, cats, kitten, or feline language and to characteristic cues such as meowing, purring, whiskers, litter boxes, paws or claws, tabby, and calico. Prefer a feature that generalizes across cat contexts over a narrower lexical feature centered on kitty or kitten, the name Kitty, Kitty Hawk, or ambiguous uses of pussy.
